title: A Brief History of Athletics
content:
Athletics is one of the oldest sports in the world. It includes running, jumping, and throwing events.

Athletics was part of the first modern Olympic Games in 1896, in Athens, Greece.

Today, athletes compete in events such as the 100-meter race, long jump, high jump, and shot put.

One interesting fact is that the 100-meter race can take less than ten seconds for the fastest athletes in the world.

Athletics is a sport that tests speed, strength, and endurance.
